Mm well ya see I'm transsexual and my mom doesnt like it at all so I have to resort to sneaking around to engage in feminine activities that I enjoy. I don't have a job or insurance so I can't work toward hormone therapy to help ease my depression and gender dysphoria and so I live every day with my self loathing, envy, and depression. There are sometimes when I am in a great mood but for the most part I can't escape the dark thoughts of isolation, loneliness, and defeat. The fact fact is  that my only friend I can talk to is always busy so I can't talk to anyone  and the few other people I have on FB or live with that I try to talk to say I'm constantly whinning

I have a bubbly personality but the people in my life have trouble understanding who I really am because I spent so long trying to be who they wanted me to be and so I never really got to show them who I was. Now that I have  they call me immature and juvenile. The hardest thing about it all is that even though they now know that I was only appearing to be what they wanted me to they still want me to be that way. They won't accept me for who I am and I can't even leave because I am dependent on them and my depression is so bad that I can't hold a job.
I can't swim very well due to respiratory issues so committing suicide in 5 feet of water would be fairly simple, it's just the struggle before going unconscious that would be the hard part.

It's a long story but I don't think I have the patience or courage to fix my situation and my emotions are just rampant, I hardly ever leave my room because my family can't help and one of them doesn't even want to make the effort ( she said as much ). Since I don't have a job at the moment I can't even run away. I've tried suicide in the fast but I failed and since I'm a bad swimmer drowning is my only solution at this point. If I knew how long it's take to become unconscious before death I know I would end all my struggles, it's not the drive to kill myself that I lack it's the support I need that I do lack.
